name: Runetotem the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, travelers in Durotar can honor Runetotem the Elder, an ancestral spirit. She waits in Razor Hill beneath a beam of heavenly light, offering blessings and festival tokens to those who remember the past.

sections.title: A Spirit in Razor Hill
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, spirits of ancient elders appear across Azeroth to commune with the living. Elder Runetotem waits inside Razor Hill, just past the southern entrance. A beam of starlight falls on her as she watches over the orcish settlement. Travelers can pause there to honor the wisdom of those who came before.

sections.title: Guidance Across the Lands
sections.body: When you pay Elder Runetotem homage, she gives you a festival token of fortune and tells you where other spirits can be found. Her directions point toward Elder Darkhorn and Elder High Mountain elsewhere across the continent.

faq.answer: Elder Runetotem waits inside Razor Hill in Durotar, just to the right after you enter through the southern entrance.

faq.q: Why is there a beam of light shining on her?
faq.answer: A shaft of celestial light marks Elder Runetotem as an honored elder, as it does the ancestral spirits who appear during the Lunar Festival.

faq.q: What do you receive for honoring Elder Runetotem?
faq.answer: You receive a festival token for honoring Elder Runetotem, and she gives directions to spirits such as Elder Darkhorn and Elder High Mountain.

faq.q: Can Alliance players visit Elder Runetotem?
faq.answer: Elder Runetotem welcomes homage from all mortals, whatever their allegiance, but Razor Hill is a guarded Horde outpost that can be perilous for Alliance travelers to reach.

aliases: who does runetotem tell you to find
faq.answer: Elder Runetotem gives directions to Elder Darkhorn and Elder High Mountain.

faq.q: Is Elder Runetotem a living tauren or a ghost?
faq.answer: Elder Runetotem is an ancestral spirit who appears during the Lunar Festival to bless those whose spirits burn with life.

angles.text: As a tauren, meeting a spirit of the Runetotem family beyond Mulgore reminds you of your people's deep spiritual heritage across Kalimdor.
As a member of the Horde, you can honor Elder Runetotem inside Razor Hill, making her one of the safest and most convenient ancestors to visit early in your travels.
As an Alliance traveler, you must cross enemy lines into Durotar to honor Elder Runetotem, risking the anger of Razor Hill's orcish guards.
